title: Disclosure under Noisy Information Processing
abstract: arXiv:2609.07898v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Capital markets process disclosures with noise. Adding this single friction overturns the standard characterization of costly voluntary disclosure. Firms may unravel to full disclosure despite strictly positive disclosure costs and, when unravelling fails, the model generically admits two equilibria rather than one. In the lower-threshold equilibrium, disclosure becomes more frequent as the cost rises and as reports become more accurate, falls with fundamental volatility when it is below the processing noise, but approaches full disclosure again when volatility grows large. These results help explain the mixed empirical evidence on the proprietary cost hypothesis and generate conditional predictions that distinguish high and low disclosure regimes. The model also explains why ESG ratings can be noisy, costly, and widely purchased, while still influencing market prices.

translated_title: 噪声信息处理下的披露
translated_abstract: 资本市场在处理披露信息时存在噪声。仅引入这一个摩擦因素便颠覆了关于有成本自愿披露的标准理论刻画。即使披露成本严格为正，企业仍可能实现完全披露；而当披露展开失败时，模型通常存在两个均衡而非一个。在较低阈值均衡中，披露随着披露成本上升和报告准确性提高而变得更加频繁；当基本面波动率低于信息处理噪声时，披露随波动率上升而减少，但当波动率变得很大时，披露再次趋近完全披露。这些结果有助于解释关于专有成本假说的混合实证证据，并产生了能够区分高披露与低披露状态的条件性预测。该模型还解释了为什么ESG评级可以是有噪声的、有成本的且被广泛购买，同时仍能影响市场价格。
tldr: 本文证明仅引入信息处理噪声这一单一摩擦即可颠覆经典自愿披露理论——即使披露成本为正也可能出现完全披露，且展开失败时通常存在两个均衡，其中低阈值均衡呈现披露频率随成本上升而增加等反直觉性质，从而解释了专有成本假说的混合实证证据以及ESG评级的市场影响力。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a single friction—noisy information processing in capital markets—overturns the standard theory of costly voluntary disclosure: full disclosure can occur despite strictly positive disclosure costs, and when unraveling fails, two equilibria typically emerge, with the lower-threshold equilibrium exhibiting counterintuitive comparative statics that help explain the mixed empirical evidence on the proprietary cost hypothesis and the market impact of ESG ratings.
